title: Replace BasicAuth with a Portta login page behind ForwardAuth

stories.title: Record the ForwardAuth architecture
stories.description: Record the separate auth service, bounded generated files, reserved path and compatibility contract.
acceptanceCriteria: ADR 0027 amends the affected authentication, panel access and dynamic-file decisions
The ADR index reflects the accepted decision
stories.notes: Recorded as ADR 0027 because ADR 0026 was already allocated on develop.

stories.title: Add the protection store and credential compatibility
stories.description: Move credential primitives into Core, add scrypt and a versioned atomic protection store.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing apr1, bcrypt and SHA credentials verify
The protection store writes atomically with mode 0600 and bumps epochs
stories.notes: Core now owns apr1, scrypt, bcrypt/SHA compatibility and the atomic versioned store.

stories.title: Serve login, sessions and abuse protection
stories.description: Create apps/auth with ForwardAuth verification, branded login, host-only sessions and rate limiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser navigation sees the Portta login and non-browser clients receive 401
Basic credentials and host-scoped sessions work
Logout, redirect validation, epoch revocation and lockout are covered
stories.notes: The standalone Hono service, session boundary, limiter and production auth UI are implemented and browser-verified.

stories.title: Wire the auth service and safe migration
stories.description: Add the auth service to Compose, generate ForwardAuth routers and migrate legacy files before switching routers.
acceptanceCriteria: The long-running auth service has no published port, Docker socket, database or dynamic-directory write access
Legacy panel and share credentials migrate idempotently
stories.notes: Compose now runs the isolated auth service, lifecycle paths migrate legacy credentials idempotently, and Core owns the self-bypass-safe ForwardAuth file.

stories.title: Migrate panel, shares and project protection
stories.description: Keep panel/share commands compatible and add host protection management for consumer projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel and protected shares use ForwardAuth without hashes in Traefik files
portta auth protect, unprotect and status manage project hostname records
stories.notes: Panel and share flows now use the private store and ForwardAuth; project owners can manage host records with portta auth while retaining ownership of router labels.

stories.title: Update diagnostics and documentation
stories.description: Teach installer, doctor, diagnostics and docs about the auth service and reserved path.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing secret, unhealthy auth and unsafe store modes are diagnosed
Authentication, security, sharing, panel and project adoption docs are current
stories.notes: Host and panel diagnostics now fail on a missing signing secret, invalid or non-private protection store, and missing or unhealthy auth service; operator, panel, sharing, public-access and adoption documentation is current.

stories.title: Validate every protected-access flow
stories.description: Run unit, integration, browser and repository-wide verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Typecheck, tests, build and shell suites pass
Login UI and the critical browser flow are verified
The develop worktree ends in consistent commits with no unrelated changes
stories.notes: Lint, typecheck, build, OpenAPI, all Node suites and the complete non-Docker shell suite pass; the login UI and successful browser submit were verified. Docker E2E was intentionally not run because active user-owned demo-b containers share the destructive test namespace.
